name: FRIE Curated Financial Reference Set
description: Curated reference dataset with positive entries across 14 financial categories and non-financial hard negatives.
attribution: Authored specifically for FRIE reference similarity matching.

categories.invoices_and_billing: Invoices, billing, purchase orders, accounts payable and receivable
categories.loans_and_interest: Loans, principal, interest, and repayment schedules
categories.rent_leases_recurring_payments: Rent, leases, deposits, and recurring payments
categories.contractual_financial_obligations: Contracts, payment obligations, penalties, refunds and settlements
categories.maturity_renewals_deadlines: Maturity dates, renewals, installments, and payment deadlines

category_aliases_note: Entry categories in the JSONL may use legacy aliases; app.taxonomy.CATEGORY_ALIASES migrates them to these canonical names on load.
